facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on SG-9000 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 5 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-9000 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-9000 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-9000 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 29 October 2009 an incident occurred on SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
